title: A Language for the Radiators
author: Cyrus Ishikawa
blurb: Mara Whitlock, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
